# CG-RES-013: Response pattern or format relaxed or changed

A response pattern or format was removed, widened or replaced.

**Why it matters:** Consumers may parse values according to the documented format.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.patternChanged`, `schema.formatChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: medium · potentially breaking: low · undetermined: low |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {what} of {where} changed ({from} → {to}).
>
> Values that consumers did not expect may now be returned.
>
> **Fix:** Confirm that consumers do not depend on the previous format or pattern.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: format uuid removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, format: uuid}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. Format of GET /x: response 200 (application/json) changed (uuid → none).

### Fires: pattern edited

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, pattern: '^a'}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, pattern: '^b'}}}}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, low. Pattern of GET /x: response 200 (application/json) changed (^a → ^b).

### Fires: format changed to an unrelated one

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, format: date}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, format: uuid}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. Format of GET /x: response 200 (application/json) changed (date → uuid).

### Does not fire: pattern added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, pattern: '^a'}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

```yaml

      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
```
